review.note: Extracted as text from the old lesson, then reviewed against the verified dataset. A line with "review" set is held (not shown) until a teacher resolves it. Dropped: the five Tajweed rules, the Tajweed quiz question and the five Tajweed games (Tajweed comes only from the reviewed dataset), the audio URLs and the reciter line, the reason-for-revelation paragraph (it quotes another surah's ayah, 26:214, as typed Quran), and every hand-typed Quran string (replaced by positions). The complete-the-ayah words are the answers of the old "complete the ayah" and "missing word" games; the two-word answers (dhata lahab, min masad) became their last word. The old quiz had difficulty levels (easy, medium, hard), not categories; the categories were assigned by question type. Lessons learned keep each card's sentence; its short title is not carried. The reflection is the old prompt's question, with the "how we apply these lessons" tips as its ideas (its second line, "how can we apply it", is not carried). Emoji were stripped from the ends of lines. Not carried over (the engine has no such games yet): the order, build-the-ayah and memory games, the word-to-meaning matching games and the meaning multiple-choice games (same words and meanings as the list and quiz), and the intro quiz (surah name, ayah count).

intro.text: سورة المسد نزلت في أبي لهب عم النبي ﷺ وزوجته، لأنهما كانا يؤذيان النبي ﷺ ويمنعان الناس من الإسلام.

tafsir.text: خسر أبو لهب خسارة كبيرة بسبب عداوته للنبي ﷺ
لم ينفعه ماله الكثير ولا أعماله في شيء
tafsir.review: Reads "ma kasab" as "his deeds". Many tafsir (Ibn Abbas, Mujahid) say "ma kasab" is his children; others his earnings and standing. Teacher to choose.

tafsir.text: سيدخل ناراً كبيرة مشتعلة يوم القيامة
وزوجته التي كانت تضع الأشواك في طريق النبي ﷺ لتؤذيه
في رقبتها حبل خشن من ليف النخل

words.meaning: عم النبي ﷺ واسمه عبد العزى
words.review: PHRASE: the old entry is the two words "abi lahab" (1:3-4); the engine shows one word, so this points at abi (1:3) and the meaning covers both. Teacher to confirm it reads right.

PHRASE: the old entry is the two words "ma aghna" (2:1-2); the engine shows one word, so this points at aghna (2:2) and the meaning covers both. Teacher to confirm it reads right. The negation is in the meaning.
Gives "his work and what he gathered". Many tafsir (Ibn Abbas, Mujahid) say "ma kasab" is his children; others his earnings and standing. Teacher to choose.
PHRASE: the old entry is the two words "dhata lahab" (3:3-4); the engine shows one word, so this points at dhata (3:3) and the meaning covers both. Teacher to confirm it reads right.
PHRASE: the old entry is the two words "hammalat al-hatab" (4:2-3); the engine shows one word, so this points at hammalah (4:2) and the meaning covers both. Teacher to confirm it reads right.

quiz.question: ما أول كلمة في سورة المسد؟
quiz.review: CHANGED: the old distractors "bismi" and "qul" were hand-typed Quran not in this surah; they are now the first words of ayat 4 and 2. The answer (tabbat, 1:1) is unchanged.

quiz.question: ماذا كانت تفعل زوجة أبي لهب؟

options.text: تضع الأشواك في طريق النبي ﷺ

quiz.question: ما معنى

options.text: التي تحمل الأشواك والحطب لإيذاء النبي ﷺ

quiz.review: PHRASE: the old question asks about "hammalat al-hatab" (4:2-3); the engine shows one word, so it points at hammalah (4:2). Teacher to confirm it reads right.

quiz.question: أكمل الآية
quiz.review: CHANGED: the old question asked for the two-word ending "dhata lahab" against made-up endings (dhata hatab, dhata adhab, dhata nur: not Quran). It now shows three words and asks for lahab (3:4); the distractors al-hatab (4:3), masad (5:5) and habl (5:3) are words of this surah.

quiz.question: ما الدرس الأهم من سورة المسد؟

lessons.text: نتعلم أن الإيمان بالله ورسوله ﷺ هو أهم شيء في حياتنا
المال والثروة لا تنفع صاحبها إذا لم يكن مؤمناً بالله
لا نؤذي أحداً بالكلام أو الفعل، بل نكون لطفاء مع الجميع
نحب النبي محمداً ﷺ ونتبع تعاليمه الكريمة
نتعلم الصبر كما صبر النبي ﷺ على أذى أبي لهب

reflection.question: ما أجمل شيء تعلمته من سورة المسد؟
ideas: نكون لطفاء مع الجميع ولا نؤذي أحداً
نحب النبي ﷺ ونتبع سنته الكريمة
نعلم أن المال وحده لا ينفع بدون إيمان وعمل صالح
نصبر على الأذى كما صبر النبي ﷺ
نشكر الله على نعمه ونطيع والدينا

didYouKnow.text: سورة المسد هي السورة رقم 111 في القرآن الكريم
سورة المسد تتكون من 5 آيات فقط
المسد يعني الحبل المصنوع من ليف النخل
أبو لهب هو عم النبي ﷺ واسمه الحقيقي عبد العزى
سورة المسد نزلت في مكة المكرمة
قراءة القرآن كل يوم تجعلنا أقرب إلى الله
كل حرف نقرأه من القرآن له حسنة والحسنة بعشر أمثالها
حفظ القرآن يجعل قلبنا نظيفاً وسعيداً
